verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips for tracking people. Discussions about chips or barcodes were related to tracking vaccine vials for distribution purposes, not for injection into individuals.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming body of evidence from multiple independent fact-checking organizations and government sources confirms that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. Sources like FactCheck.org and Indonesian government portals clarify that any tracking technology discussed was for managing vaccine inventory by placing chips or barcodes on vials, not for injection into people. Various related claims, such as vaccines having magnetic properties or being linked to Bill Gates for tracking purposes, have also been consistently debunked.
